title: Accessories & Merchandise - Manager
minimumQualification: UG: Any Graduate; PG: Any Postgraduate
jobDescription:
Job Purpose: To lead the business development, sales, and profitability of the Accessories and Merchandise division for EV two-wheelers. The role involves developing product portfolios, dealer engagement, pricing, marketing strategies, and ensuring accessory fitment integration with EV models to enhance customer experience, personalization, and brand identity. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
1. Business Strategy & Sales Drive sales and revenue growth for Genuine Accessories and Lifestyle Merchandise across dealer and digital channels. Formulate and execute sales plans aligned with EV model launches and after-sales lifecycle. Build business forecasts, analyze trends, and implement strategies to achieve sales targets. Identify and onboard channel partners and vendors for accessories and merchandise expansion.
2. Product Portfolio Management A. EV Two-Wheeler Genuine Accessories Performance & Utility: Fast chargers, battery lock kits, mobile chargers, footrests, luggage carriers, side stands, center stands. Protection & Safety: Frame sliders, crash guards, side shields, seat covers, floor mats, handlebar guards. Styling & Comfort: Windscreens, alloy wheel caps, custom grips, backrests, seat cushions, foot pegs. Connectivity & Tech: GPS trackers, phone mounts, smart display covers, Bluetooth-enabled accessories. Vehicle-Specific Enhancements: Floorboard mats, rear-view mirror sets, number plate frames, EV branding decals. B. Branded Merchandise Riding Gear: Helmets, jackets, gloves, knee guards. Lifestyle Apparel: T-shirts, hoodies, caps, raincoats, shoes. Collectibles & Utility: Keychains, mugs, bottles, bags, stickers, eco-friendly products, and limited-edition brand merchandise.
3. Dealer Network & Retail Operations Design and implement dealer programs for accessory and merchandise upselling. Ensure accessory display, inventory, and visual merchandising standards are maintained. Conduct regular dealer training for retail staff to enhance cross-selling and customer experience. Track fitment ratio per vehicle sold and increase attach rate of accessories.
4. Marketing & Brand Promotion Collaborate with the marketing team to create promotional campaigns for new launches and limited editions. Support digital commerce and OEM website integration for accessory & merchandise sales. Plan and execute pop-up stores, test ride events, and EV rallies to promote lifestyle merchandise. Develop catalogues, price lists, and promotional creatives for both physical and digital channels.
5. Supply Chain & Operations Coordinate with supply chain, vendors, and production to ensure timely product availability. Monitor inventory health, reorder levels, and ageing stocks at central and dealer warehouses. Work with the procurement team to localize and source sustainable EV accessories where possible.
6. Analysis & Reporting Track sales performance region-wise, model-wise, and product-wise. Analyze customer feedback and competitor benchmarking to optimize offerings. Present monthly business reviews and suggest actions for improving margin and turnover. Skills & Competencies: Strong understanding of EV technology and ecosystem. Knowledge of accessory design, vendor management, and fitment standards. Proficiency in SAP B1 / ERP systems, Excel analytics, and MIS reporting. Excellent communication, negotiation, and dealer management skills. Passion for automotive lifestyle, brand building, and sustainability. Requirements Educational Qualification: Graduate in Business / Engineering / Automotive; MBA preferred. Experience Required: 8–10 years of experience in Accessories / Merchandise / Aftermarket Sales within EV, Automotive (2W/4W), or Consumer Lifestyle sector. Experience in OEM accessory planning, dealer network handling, and online retail management preferred. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): Accessory & Merchandise Sales Revenue Fitment Ratio (Accessories per Vehicle Sold) Dealer Activation & Retail Display Compliance Stock Turn Ratio & Ageing Control Online Merchandise Sales Growth Customer Satisfaction & Brand Engagement Score

As we expand across cities, the brand team plays a critical role in driving both desire and dealership footfalls. Role Overview The Brand Manager will own brand campaigns that move the needle on awareness, consideration, and showroom walk-ins. This role blends sharp brand thinking with execution discipline, ensuring campaigns are not just creative, but measurable and ROI-driven. You will work closely with sales, performance marketing, regional teams, agencies, and creators to deliver campaigns that support Oben’s growth across markets. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Campaigns & GTM Execution Lead integrated brand campaigns for product launches, festive periods, and key brand moments. Plan and execute GTMs aligned to dealership expansion, city launches, and regional priorities. Build campaign narratives that clearly connect brand storytelling to test rides and footfalls. Own campaign timelines, budgets, and execution across channels. Brand Films & Creative Direction Conceptualise ideas for brand films, launch films, and short-format videos. Work with creative agencies and production partners from ideation to final delivery. Ensure all creative work reflects Oben’s positioning and appeals to urban commuters. Micro Social & Localised Campaigns Plan micro social media campaigns tailored to specific cities, regions, and dealership clusters. Collaborate with social and performance teams to convert brand content into traffic and leads. Use customer stories, city insights, and cultural moments to drive relevance. Media Planning & Offline Visibility Have a working understanding of media buying across billboards, newspapers, and TV. Coordinate with media agencies to plan high-impact, location-led offline media. Ensure outdoor and print campaigns are mapped to dealership catchment areas. Track effectiveness of offline media in driving showroom awareness and visits. Influencer & Creator Partnerships Identify and collaborate with influencers relevant to commuting, motorcycles, tech, and lifestyle. Design influencer campaigns that drive curiosity, test ride intent, and showroom visits. Build longer-term creator relationships aligned with Oben’s brand voice. Measure influencer impact beyond views, including engagement quality and footfall influence. Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with sales and dealer teams to align brand campaigns with on-ground execution. Partner with performance marketing to link brand activity with leads and test rides. Coordinate with PR to amplify key brand stories and milestones. KPI & Success Metrics The Brand Manager’s success will be measured on brand impact + business outcomes. Campaign Performance Increase in brand awareness and consideration across key markets. Engagement quality on brand campaigns (views, watch time, shares, saves). Timely delivery of campaigns within planned budgets. Footfall & Business Impact Incremental showroom footfalls driven during and post campaigns. Test ride uplift during GTM and city-level brand campaigns. Cost per footfall improvement over time through smarter media and targeting. Strong linkage between brand bursts and lead quality. ROI & Efficiency Clear ROI reporting for brand campaigns and offline media spends. Ability to justify spends with outcome-based metrics, not just impressions. Improved performance of repeatable campaign formats across cities. Influencer & Content Effectiveness Engagement rate and relevance of influencer content. Consistent test ride or showroom mentions driven by creator campaigns. Growth of Oben’s owned content library for reuse across channels. Brand Consistency Consistent brand tone and quality across digital, offline, dealerships, and media. Positive feedback from internal teams, dealers, and partners on brand clarity. Requirements What We’re Looking For 4 years of experience in brand marketing, preferably in auto, EV, or consumer brands. Strong campaign thinking with an understanding of how brands drive business outcomes. Hands-on experience with agencies, creators, and media partners. Comfort working with numbers, dashboards, and post-campaign reports. High ownership mindset and ability to work across fast-moving teams.
